reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; the cited paragraph (a Credit Data licence cross-referencing a separate Non-Competition Agreement) contains no personnel solicitation, hiring or inducement restriction, so the rule's preferred position is met.
No redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original paragraph.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable rather than probative here — there is no covenant whose term or carve-outs could be measured, so they do not evidence a deviation.

Rationale appropriately notes as file commentary only that the separately executed Non-Competition Agreement is outside this document and should be reviewed under this rule in its own right; that does not convert this into a deviation or missing finding.
